title: Family suing RCMP, paramedics over death
article: The family of a man who died two years ago after being held in police custody is suing the RCMP and the paramedics who gave him medical treatment.
Ian Alexander Young, 55, was found by paramedics in October 2008 lying half on the sidewalk and half on the road in Maple Ridge.
They decided Young did not need to be taken to hospital and instead asked for help from RCMP.
